caption: A macro shot frames a plant against a soft green backdrop, with a serrated leaf filling the upper left and a thin reddish stem hanging near the centre. A pale, curled hook-like structure sits beside an intact, elongated, ridged green seed pod that points down-right, while a lower leaf edge anchors the bottom of the frame. For the opening stretch the pod and hook hold their positions with little visible motion. Then the pod wall splits, its edges curling and blurring. The structure bursts open, whipping pale fragments outward and flinging several dark, elongated seeds away from the stem. The ejected seeds drift upward and outward, some leaving the frame, while the original pod body is no longer visible. The pale hook relaxes into a more vertical tendril, and a small green curled ring fragment stays suspended near the bottom. The parts continue to move as the clip runs on.
relations: The splitting pod wall releases stored tension, flinging dark seeds and pale fragments outward from the stem.
As the pod bursts, the curled pale hook relaxes into a more vertical tendril.
Ejected seeds and fragments drift upward and outward, leaving the original pod body no longer visible.
A small green curled ring fragment remains suspended near the bottom as the parts continue moving.
